info.description: Replicant Space is an API-based sci-fi multiplayer game. Explore star systems, mine resources, build devices, and expand across our ever expanding galaxy. See https://replicant.space/docs/ for documentation.
info.title: Replicant Space

BearerAuth.description: Account API token. Obtain one by registering via POST /v1/accounts.

muted.description: Wildcard patterns for events to suppress (e.g. 'mining.*', '*.completed')

subscribed.description: Message categories to receive as email (e.g. 'alert', 'progression')

status.description: One of: stationary, travelling, mining, offline

location.description: Location code (e.g. 'LACASAW-3'); null when in deep space

is_npc.description: Mark this replicant as an NPC (suppressable BobNet chatter)

destination.description: Star designation (e.g., 'BWMT') for interstellar, or location code (e.g., 'BWMT-3') for in-system cruise

via.description: Route mode: 'auto' (default), 'direct', or list of waypoint locations

dry_run.description: If true, return the computed route without initiating travel.

outer_system.description: Kuiper belt and Oort cloud designations/distances

location.description: Location code (e.g. 'LACASAW-3'); null when undeployed or in motion
Location code (e.g. 'LACASAW-3'); null when undeployed or in deep space

waiting_for.description: Resources still needed for a queued print: {resource: {need, have}}

tags.description: Declarative tag list. Replaces all current tags. Mutually exclusive with add_tags/remove_tags.

add_tags.description: Tags to add to the device. Mutually exclusive with tags.

remove_tags.description: Tags to remove from the device. Mutually exclusive with tags.

linked_device.description: Device code to link to this device (e.g. an empty_replicant_matrix for a slingshot).

last_active.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last message

type.description: Board type: 'ranked' for flat leaderboards, 'nested' for scenario-based sub-leaderboards

value.description: Board metric: integer for count-based boards (xp, fleet, trades), float for distance/reputation, integer for megastructure value.

type.description: Feedback category: typo, bug, or idea

replicant_name.description: Must match a replicant on your account

published_at.description: Defaults to now; can be future

message_type.description: Message type: system, story, discovery, etc.

via.description: Route mode: 'auto', 'direct', or list of waypoints

dry_run.description: Preview the route without initiating travel

tags.description: Tags to apply to the new device

flatpack.description: Print the device in a compacted state (modular devices only)

designation.description: Star or body designation to rename

direction.description: Direction vector [x, y, z] to prospect toward (default: outward from galaxy centre)

target.description: Reference point [x, y, z] coordinates for triangulation

have a replicant at the event's location. Resolver replicant is
auto-picked: most recently arrived (LIFO) at the location.

get.summary: List trade controllers visible to a replicant.
get.description:

- All traders in the replicant's current star system (local)
- If the replicant has a FTL relay in their system: traders in any system
  where the shop owner also has a relay (galaxy-wide via relay network)
